'''Dedric''' is an [[Aiel]] from the [[Jaern Rift]] [[Codarra]] Clan. He is an ''[[Aethan Dor]]''.

== Appearance ==
He has yellow hair.

== Activities ==
He escorts [[Rand al'Thor]] when he goes to the School in [[Cairhien]]. The Maiden [[Jalani]] shows interest in him.
